what_is_absent: A market field (scopes) in the order cancellation settings (settings center section /orders/cancellation, form order-cancellation-form): the form takes enabled, hours, days, window_hours, statuses and the cancellation reasons for the store, where the same settings center gives guest checkout an option scopes (S02-SA-439)

A market field (scopes) in the notifications settings (settings center section /notifications): each notification is a field with the toggle in_app, sent to /notifications/v1/inbox/preferences/, where the same settings center gives guest checkout an option scopes (S02-SA-439)

A market field (scopes) in the settings center's apps section (/apps): the section holds a search field q and a filter status (the installed apps' statuses, marketplace/v2/apps/installed/statuses), then the list apps:installed-list, which fetches the installed apps (marketplace/v2/apps/installed, with page, per_page and the section's search params) and opens each app's own page (/apps/id?app-id=…); where the same settings center gives guest checkout an option scopes (S02-SA-439)

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the checkout page options, whose route is settings/checkout, a child of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the store's email and phone shown to customers, whose route is settings/information, a child of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the inventory withdrawal priority, whose route is catalog/inventories/withdrawal-priority, a child of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for an app's activation, where the tracking apps take their account code, whose route is apps/:id, a child of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the apps a store installs and their settings, whose routes are apps/installed and apps/:id, children of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the staff notifications, whose route is settings/staff-notifications, a child of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the team and its groups' permissions, whose routes are settings/team and settings/team/groups/create, children of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the store's privacy policy, whose route is channels/online-store/pages/legal/privacy-policy, a child of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the store's time zone, whose route is settings/information/address, a child of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the exchange and return policy, whose route is channels/online-store/pages/legal/exchange-and-returns, a child of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A route under a market (settings/markets/:id/...) for the store's own country (Business address > Country, business_location), whose route is settings/information/address, a child of $lang.stores.$storeId: the routes under a market are settings/markets/:id/manage, settings/markets/:id/products and settings/markets/:id/price-managing

A setting of the business or legal entity that sells to the buyer (a business entity, a legal name or a merchant of record), for the store or per selling location, and who sets it, among WooCommerce's settings pages: the General page's Store Address holds where the business is located, and the Point of Sale page's Store details hold the physical store's name, address, phone, email and refund and returns policy shown in email receipts; no page names a business entity, a legal entity or a merchant of record

A setting that places a customer in a selling location (a market), or lets a customer choose one or sends them to one (a country selector, a redirect), and who sets it, among WooCommerce's settings pages: the settings on a customer's location are the General page's Default customer location (woocommerce_default_customer_address, S02-WC-023), the Shipping page's Shipping destination (woocommerce_ship_to_destination) and the Tax page's Calculate tax based on (woocommerce_tax_based_on, S02-WC-206); none places a customer in a selling location

A setting that makes the store's extensions (apps) take a value per selling location, per country or per customer's country, and who sets it, among WooCommerce's settings pages: the Integration page shows each integration's own settings, and the Advanced page's WooCommerce.com section holds Marketplace suggestions (woocommerce_show_marketplace_suggestions), one setting for the store; no page names a country or a selling location for an extension
